As state elections loom, journalists investigate working-class sentiments in Magdeburg and Rügen, revealing deep-seated frustration and susceptibility to right-wing narratives.

The Bright Side:
Despite parroting extremist talking points, individual voters still express surprisingly humane, empathetic views on local integration and fairness when discussing concrete situations.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is confusing stated political alignment (WHO they vote for) with their actual underlying values (WHAT they believe). The bait-and-switch occurs when propaganda replaces lived experience.

Social Physics Analysis:
Voters execute a Smart Selfish Maneuver by projecting systemic economic anxieties onto scapegoats, using manufactured crises to justify voting for extremist platforms that offer no real solutions.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Cognitive dissonance prevents systemic resolution.

The Unavoidable Truth: Lived human empathy still exists beneath political polarization.
The Unavoidable Lie: Extremist votes are driven purely by rational economic abandonment.

The data reveals a systemic feedback loop where media consumption overrides physical reality, causing actors to vote against their own stated values.
